registryEntry.label: Connect Office 365 Data Connector to Sentinel
registryEntry.set_command: $f = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'stamper-sentinel-body.json'; @{kind='Office365';properties=@{tenantId='{tenantId}';dataTypes=@{exchange=@{state='Enabled'};sharePoint=@{state='Enabled'};teams=@{state='Enabled'}}}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress | Set-Content -Path $f -Encoding UTF8; az rest --method PUT --url 'https://management.usgovcloudapi.net/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroup}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{lawWorkspaceName}/providers/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/dataConnectors/office365?api-version=2024-03-01' --headers Content-Type=application/json --body "@$f"; Remove-Item $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

metadata.commandExecuted: $f = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'stamper-sentinel-body.json'; @{kind='Office365';properties=@{tenantId='{tenantId}';dataTypes=@{exchange=@{state='Enabled'};sharePoint=@{state='Enabled'};teams=@{state='Enabled'}}}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress | Set-Content -Path $f -Encoding UTF8; az rest --method PUT --url 'https://management.usgovcloudapi.net/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroup}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{lawWorkspaceName}/providers/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/dataConnectors/office365?api-version=2024-03-01' --headers Content-Type=application/json --body "@$f"; Remove-Item $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
